description: ONE-SHOT local-file quiz authoring image upload (stdio-only convenience over the same registry op as prepare/finalize): checks the file (regular, non-empty, at most 5 MiB), infers or checks the MIME type, computes SHA-256, prepares with your idempotencyKey (finalize uses "<key>:f"), PUTs through the grant and finalizes with server-side verification. No signed URL appears in the result. Then put `imageNode` into a question's rich content in the draft (form_update_draft) and set `attrs.alt` to a short description, or `attrs.decorative: true` for an image that carries no meaning. The draft accepts only READY images of the same form or job. Employer-only: needs project_todos:write (list: project_todos:read), a claimed account and access to the form's job; a missing, foreign, other-job, archived or organization-level form is one 404. Images are private: no storage path or delivery URL is returned, and bytes never travel in a request body or as base64.
name: opentrain_quiz_form_image_upload
